description: The quoted call's retained callable (`__fz_bound__`), `__fz_module__` and `__fz_lexical__` travel today as reserved entries of the visible quoted-metadata map, validated at the read boundary (World::try_function_ref + arity for the callable) rather than physically inaccessible to a macro that edits the map. The parent asks for inline heap-owned bytes on the map, outside its entries. Doing that needs, together: a runtime Map header flag beside MAP_DESTINATION_FLAG (runtime/src/any_value.rs) with a trailing payload and matching size_of_map/map_size_for_count (GC forwards by strict_object_size, so it rides along); one new prim in the DestMap* family implemented on the interpreter, Cranelift and AOT doors; preservation across map_put_value/alloc_map_destination/freeze; inclusion in values_eq and the canon/AOT encodings. Move all three keys onto it in one motion; moving one alone is wasted work. Signal: a macro that rewrites the metadata map cannot forge or drop the classification; the reserved META_* keys and their read-boundary validation are deleted.
title: Inline heap-owned annotation on the quoted metadata map
